verdict.line: You lose if she lands Flawless Duet (E) first and chains a Bladesurge (Q) reset before your Path Maker (W) is up; you win if you force the fight on your W (Path Maker) stun or your All Out (R) timer.

brief.thesis: This is a 52.5% K'Sante lane over 61 games because your CC is harder and more reliable than hers: Path Maker (W) is a guaranteed charge-then-stun on a 14→10s cooldown, while her only hard CC is Flawless Duet (E), a two-blade pincer on 16→10s cooldown that she must land cleanly on both sides to stun and Mark you. Outside of that window she only has a single-target dash (Bladesurge, Q) and a damage-reduction charge (Defiant Dance, W), neither of which locks you down. Overall shape is even because her Ionian Fervor attack-speed stacking and Vanguard's Edge (R) wall scale her into fights your early lane edge doesn't carry forward.

theirWindow.when: E (Flawless Duet) off cooldown and up
theirWindow.what: If both blades converge on you, you're stunned and Marked, and her Bladesurge (Q) will refresh off the Mark — expect a second Q immediately after. Hold E (Footwork) shield for the follow-up hit instead of using it to dodge the first stun.

yourWindow.when: She uses Q (Bladesurge) or W (Defiant Dance) on a minion
yourWindow.what: Her gap-closer or damage mitigation is down for 6-10s (Q) or 12-20s (W). Walk in and commit Path Maker (W) — the charge's damage reduction covers your approach and the stun locks her for your Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks.

start.why: 94.1% pick rate at 51.6% win over 64 games — the sustain outlasts her Q/E poke chip damage through the pre-6 trades.

boots.why: 89.7% pick at 52.5% win — directly cuts the on-hit damage her Ionian Fervor passive stacks up during extended trades.

core.why: Grievous Wounds shuts down her Q (Bladesurge) self-heal on-hit, the main thing keeping her even in prolonged trades.
Adds a slow proc off your Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits, stacking extra peel on top of her already-reduced mobility post-stun.
Stacking resistances scale you into the even late game where her attack speed stacking otherwise catches up.

she's ahead and you need omnivamp to survive extended skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Triggers on your melee autos during short trades, which matches how you fight her — in close with Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacking rather than kiting at range.

summoners.why: 87.9% pick rate — Teleport lets you reset top after your early lane-win trades and still answer her All Out (R)-era splitpush threat; Flash covers your W (Path Maker) engage range.

playing.title: Bait her E before you commit
playing.detail: Flawless Duet (E) is her only hard CC on a 16-10s cooldown. Hold your W (Path Maker) charge until she's thrown it or it's clearly on cooldown so you're not stunned mid-charge.

playing.title: Deny her Bladesurge minion resets
playing.detail: Her Q (Bladesurge) cooldown refreshes if the target is Marked or dies — don't let her last-hit near you with a free dash available. Trade when she has to walk, not dash, to reach you.

playing.title: Stack Q before you all-in
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes (Q) grants a stack on hit; at 2 stacks it fires a pulling shockwave. Land two Qs before using W (Path Maker) so the stun chains straight into the pull.

playing.title: Use R to end fights, not start poke
playing.detail: All Out (R) is 120-80s cooldown depending on rank — it knocks her through walls and removes her backline escape. Save it for a committed all-in, not a neutral trade.

playing.title: Respect her W during your all-in
playing.detail: Defiant Dance (W) reduces the physical damage she takes while charging. Don't dump cooldowns into her while she's visibly charging it — wait out the window or interrupt with your stun first.

playing.title: Push with Thornmail up
playing.detail: Once Thornmail is complete, her Q sustain is heavily cut by Grievous Wounds — this is your best window to shove and force tempo before her items catch up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own tactical read, not scraped data.
